description: This file defines the MidiSynthDeviceService class which extends MidiDeviceService, managing a MIDI synthesizer engine (SynthEngine), handling lifecycle events, and device status changes for MIDI input ports within an Android application.

classes.name: MidiSynthDeviceService
classes.description: Android MIDI device service that manages a software synthesizer engine, handling device connect/disconnect events and providing MIDI input receivers.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Called when the service is created; calls superclass implementation.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Stops the synthesizer engine and calls superclass implementation during service destruction.

methods.name: onGetInputPortReceivers
methods.description: Returns the MIDI receivers for input ports, connecting them to the synthesizer engine.

methods.name: onDeviceStatusChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in device connection status, starting or stopping the synthesizer engine accordingly.
